## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test`, and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Matching documentation in `docs-site/` updated (or N/A for internal-only refactor)
- [ ] `npm run docs:generate` run and generated files committed
- [ ] `npm run docs:check` and `npm run docs:build` pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] Screenshots refreshed (`npm run docs:screenshots`) if UI changed
